data.one_liner: Read and extract text from PDF files on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides a PDFDoc API to load PDFs from files, paths, or URLs and retrieve the document's text, page count, and metadata. Supports lazy loading and caching of page text.
use_when: You need to display or search PDF content as plain text in a Flutter app
You require cross‑platform PDF text extraction without writing native code
avoid_when: You need advanced PDF rendering or editing features
You target web or desktop platforms
strengths: Uses native PDFKit on iOS and PdfBox on Android for reliable extraction
Lazy loading caches page text for performance
weaknesses: No rendering capabilities, only text extraction
